intent: Drop zone plus a list of file rows with progress, done, and error states. Presentational: the app does the upload; FileUpload reports picked files and renders the state it is given.
useWhen: Attaching files to a form, message, or record
Showing per-file upload progress, completion, and failures with retry
Inside Field when the upload needs a label, hint, or error
doNotUseWhen: A single overall task percent with no file rows — use Progress
Choosing an avatar or image crop — not this component
Picking a value from a list — use Select
Uploading on the network — FileUpload has no fetch; the app owns the request

onFilesSelected.note: (files: File[]) => void. Called after a pick or a drop. Dropped files are filtered by accept; multiple=false keeps the first.

files.note: { id, name, size (bytes), progress? (0 to 100), status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error', error? }[]. Rows render in this order.

onRemove.note: (id) => void. When set, every row shows a remove Button (X while uploading, Trash2 after).

onRetry.note: (id) => void. When set, error rows show a retry Button.

accept.note: Same as the input accept attribute: extensions (.pdf) and MIME types (image/*).

maxSizeLabel.note: Hint under the drop zone text, e.g. 'SVG, PNG or PDF, max 10 MB'. Text only; the app enforces limits and reports them as row errors.

id.note: Drop zone button id. Inside Field, pass the same value as htmlFor.

describedBy.note: Set by Field (hint or error id).

error.note: Set by Field when it has an error. Danger border on the drop zone, like Input.

requirements: Drop zone is a button that opens the hidden file input; Enter and Space work. Drag and drop is an enhancement.
The file input is hidden and out of the tab order
Drop zone hint (maxSizeLabel) is linked with aria-describedby, plus Field's hint or error id
Each row's status text (Uploading, Complete, or the error) sits in aria-live=polite; the percent does not, so ticks are not announced
Uploading rows use Progress with ariaLabel 'Uploading {name}'
Remove Button has aria-label 'Remove {name}'; retry Button has aria-label 'Retry {name}'
Status is never color alone: icon plus text
Focus ring uses --focus-ring at --border-focus-width, like Button

doNot: Do not invent Dropzone, FileInput, FileList, FileRow, UploadItem, or UploadProgress
Do not fetch or upload inside the component — the app owns the request and passes files back
Do not use a native progress element — rows compose kit Progress
Do not show a raw input type=file as the control
Do not rely on color alone for done or error
snippet:
<Field label="Attachments" htmlFor="attachments" hint="Up to 5 files.">
  <FileUpload
    id="attachments"
    accept=".pdf,image/*"
    maxSizeLabel="SVG, PNG or PDF, max 10 MB"
    files={files}
    onFilesSelected={startUploads}
    onRemove={removeFile}
    onRetry={retryFile}
  />
</Field>
